provenance: BetaNYC modified this data: left some records out, reshaped it, and joined it with other data. This copy should not be considered the official record. Official record: Socrata Discovery API (Tyler Technologies), https://dev.socrata.com/docs/other/discovery

Read by BetaNYC's nightly harvest (GitHub Actions) and published as a SQLite index on this repo's GitHub Releases. The server downloads that index once and checks for a newer one. Nothing on a portal is called when you ask, except by check_source. The harvest reads each Socrata portal through the Discovery API every night.

Modified by BetaNYC: BetaNYC's nightly harvest reads each portal's catalog, keeps only data records (not stories, charts or pages) and drops records whose map extent is outside New York. It copies each record's title, description, tags, columns, formats, dates and links into one search index, and joins each record to its registry row, so a row carries the portal's source_id and the government body's registry_id. Titles, descriptions and other values are kept as the portal gives them.
